statement:
∀ (F : Type) (inst : NormedAddCommGroup F) (inst' : NormedSpace ℝ F)
(f : WaveMap.X n × ℝ → F) (A : Set (WaveMap.X n)) (I : Set ℝ) (c : F),
IsOpen A → IsOpen I → (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ r ∈ I, f (x,r) = c) →
∀ x ∈ A, ∀ r ∈ I,
deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (x,s)) r = 0 ∧
∀ j : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fun y : WaveMap.X n => f (y,r)) x (Pi.single j 1) = 0
proof:
intro F inst inst' f A I c hA hI hf x hx r hr
constructor
· have he : (fun s : ℝ => f (x,s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 r] (fun _ => c) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hI.mem_nhds hr) (fun s hs => hf x hx s hs)
  rw [he.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
· have he : (fun y : WaveMap.X n => f (y,r)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => c) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hA.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hf y hy r hr)
  intro j
  rw [he.fderiv_eq]
  simp
